method: Normal Rate = highest of (i) the integrated day-ahead ACP (DAM, G-DAM, HP-DAM volume-weighted), (ii) the RTM ACP and (iii) (I-DAM + RTM + Ancillary Service Charge) / 3, per the notified CERC DSM Regulations 2024. The ASC is recovered from the Normal Rate the RPCs publish in their block-wise DSM data: where that rate sits above both market prices, ASC = 3 × NR − I-DAM − RTM. Days after the latest published RPC week show a lower bound (market terms only) until the ASC is published.
